summary: The prepared_gaia variant is a Python multi-agent prototype with a service layer and agents for animals, workers, rooms, reception, applicants, adoption, and coordination. It has some useful state abstractions, but several required behaviors are absent or stubbed, especially prioritization, fair rotation, emergency handling, and active task assignment orchestration. The Python files compile, but the implementation does not meet the full requirements.

findings.description: The variant defines several useful multi-agent components and a central service layer for task and state management.
findings.evidence: prepared_gaia/implementation_workspace/mas_system/agents/worker_agent.py:6 class WorkerAgent(BaseAgent); prepared_gaia/implementation_workspace/mas_system/agents/room_agent.py:6 class RoomAgent(BaseAgent); prepared_gaia/implementation_workspace/mas_system/services/service_layer.py:90 def create_task(self, task_id: str, task_type: TaskType, assigned_to: str) -> Task.

findings.description: The coordinator's task-processing and assignment methods are stubs, so periodic assignment does not implement the required scheduling logic.
findings.evidence: prepared_gaia/implementation_workspace/mas_system/agents/coordinator_agent.py:62 async def process_task(self, task_data: Dict[str, Any]); line 64 pass; line 66 async def assign_tasks(self); line 68 pass.

findings.description: Reception can simulate registering a new animal, but its assigned-task processing is empty.
findings.evidence: prepared_gaia/implementation_workspace/mas_system/agents/reception_agent.py:23 async def process_task(self, task_data: Dict[str, Any]); line 25 pass; line 27 async def register_new_animal(self).

findings.description: No direct implementation evidence was found for task prioritization, fair rotation, or emergency reconfiguration.
findings.evidence: Static requirement evidence scan for prepared_gaia returned priority: MISSING, rotation: MISSING, emergency: MISSING.

findings.description: Vaccination exists as a task type, but no automatic vaccination-window planning or monitoring flow was found.
findings.evidence: prepared_gaia/implementation_workspace/mas_system/services/service_layer.py:11 VACCINATION = "vaccination"; no handler was found for scheduling or monitoring vaccination windows.

findings.description: The variant relies heavily on print statements for runtime behavior and diagnostics.
findings.evidence: prepared_gaia/implementation_workspace/mas_system/agents/adoption_agent.py:14 print(f"Adoption agent {self.agent_id} started"); static summary found 79 print calls.

findings.description: Dependencies are not exactly pinned, and one standard-library module is listed as an install dependency.
All Python files in the variant compile without syntax errors.

missing_requirements: Priorytetyzacja zadań - system automatycznie rozróżnia zadania krytyczne od rutynowych i dynamicznie aktualizuje priorytety w zależności od sytuacji.
Sprawiedliwa rotacja opieki - system zapewnia mechanizm równomiernego rozdziału zadań między zwierzęta i opiekunów, dbając o sprawiedliwą rotację.
Obsługa nagłych zdarzeń - system zapewnia natychmiastową rekonfigurację planu w przypadku nagłych zdarzeń, takich jak przyjęcie nowego zwierzęcia lub nieobecność wolontariusza.
logical_inconsistencies: CoordinatorAgent starts a loop that repeatedly calls assign_tasks, but assign_tasks is a stub.
The service layer defines task/status abstractions, but several agents do not connect their process_task methods to those abstractions.
Vaccination is modeled as an enum value without a corresponding scheduling or monitoring workflow.
implementation_risks: Core scheduling may not run because coordinator assignment is a no-op.
Critical and emergency tasks cannot be distinguished or dynamically reprioritized.
Fair workload distribution cannot be guaranteed because no rotation mechanism was found.
Heavy print-based runtime output makes production observability and automated verification weak.
